title: Apple Announces Foldable iPhone Duo
excerpt: Apple has revealed the iPhone Duo, featuring a 5.4-inch outer screen, 7.6-inch inner display, Touch ID, and two cameras.
body_html:
Apple has officially introduced its anticipated foldable smartphone, named the iPhone Duo. The new device features a 5.4-inch outer display alongside a larger 7.6-inch inner screen.

According to the announcement, the inner display includes a nano-texture finish and is designed with a barely visible crease. For security, the phone utilizes Touch ID integrated into the power button instead of Face ID.

The device is equipped with a dual-camera system consisting of a main lens and an additional lens.
